title: Publication-Ready Heatmaps with ggplot2
text: ggheat creates publication-ready heatmaps ggplot2. accepts numeric matrices, wide data frames, tidy long-form data.

title: Publication-Ready Heatmaps with ggplot2
code: library(ggheat)  data <- read.csv(   system.file("extdata", "example.csv", package = "ggheat"),   row.names = 1,   check.names = FALSE )  ggheat(   data,   scale = "row",   cluster_rows = TRUE,   cluster_cols = TRUE ) ggheat::run_app()

title: Create a publication-ready heatmap — ggheat
text: `ggheat()` accepts numeric matrix wide data frame directly. Tidy long-form data also supported `x`, `y`, `fill` identify column, row, value variables.

title: Create a publication-ready heatmap — ggheat
code: ggheat(   data,   x = NULL,   y = NULL,   fill = NULL,   scale = c("none", "row", "column"),   cluster_rows = FALSE,   cluster_cols = FALSE,   palette = c("#3B4CC0", "#F7F7F7", "#B40426"),   midpoint = NULL,   na_color = "grey90",   show_values = FALSE,   digits = 2,   text_color = "black",   border_color = NULL,   title = NULL,   subtitle = NULL,   caption = NULL,   xlab = NULL,   ylab = NULL,   rotate_x = 45 )

title: Create a publication-ready heatmap — ggheat
text: data numeric matrix/data frame, long-form data frame. x, y, fill Column names long-form data. Supply three none. scale Standardization mode: `"none"`, `"row"`, `"column"`. cluster_rows, cluster_cols Apply hierarchical clustering rows columns? palette Three colours low, midpoint, high values. midpoint Fill-scale midpoint. `NULL` chooses zero range crosses zero median otherwise. na_color Colour used missing cells. show_values Display formatted values inside cells? digits Number decimal places used displayed values. text_color Colour displayed values. border_color Optional cell-border colour. `NULL` removes borders. title, subtitle, caption Plot annotations. xlab, ylab Axis labels. rotate_x Rotation degrees horizontal-axis labels.
